The '''Alien Quarter Cantina''' was a restaurant in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It served droids, and the [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]-aligned [[F series repair droid]] [[F-22-RGKx]] often visited the restaurant after his business was done for the day.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref>
